parameters.jsCode: const body=$json.body ?? {}; const clean=v=>String(v??'').trim(); const email=clean(body.customer?.email).toLowerCase(); const items=Array.isArray(body.items)?body.items:[]; if(!/^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/.test(email)) return [{json:{status:'rejected',reason:'invalid_email',orderId:clean(body.orderId)||'unknown'}}]; const normalized=items.map((item,index)=>({sku:clean(item?.sku)||'item-'+(index+1),price:Number(item?.price),qty:Number(item?.qty)})); if(!normalized.length||normalized.some(item=>!Number.isFinite(item.price)||item.price<0||!Number.isInteger(item.qty)||item.qty<1)) return [{json:{status:'rejected',reason:'invalid_items',orderId:clean(body.orderId)||'unknown'}}]; const total=normalized.reduce((sum,item)=>sum+item.price*item.qty,0); return [{json:{status:'accepted',orderId:clean(body.orderId)||'unknown',email,itemCount:normalized.length,total:Number(total.toFixed(2)),currency:'EUR'}}];
